prompt: Cinematic comedy sequence, 15 seconds. [SCENE 1: 0-4s] Extreme close-up: A morbidly obese, orange tabby cat is fast asleep on a tiny, expensive velvet pillow in a pristine living room. The cat’s stomach rumbles ominously, emitting a deep, bass-heavy vibration that violently shakes the coffee table. [CUT TO] [SCENE 2: 4-7s] Low angle macro shot: The cat lifts one hind leg slightly. A tiny, glowing neon-green puff of gas escapes in ultra slow-motion, accompanied by a rippling shockwave that visually warps the air around it. [CUT TO] [SCENE 3: 7-11s] Wide tracking shot: The shockwave expands violently, blowing the living room furniture, the TV, and the doors out of the house in a fiery blast of glowing green energy and flying cat hair. [CUT TO] [SCENE 4: 11-15s] Orbiting space shot: Looking down at Earth from orbit. A colossal, glowing green mushroom cloud erupts from the continent, rapidly expanding into the exact shape of a giant, glowing cat paw. Epic cinematic lighting, hyper-realistic, deep shadows.
